question.text: Close-out is done except for three verdicts that are yours, not a runner's. (1) The ticks-tracker items 421, ep3 and 4ik: I have the gate evidence (b0d20c5 green, every package ok) but closing 4ik declares ticfac Phase 1 complete, and its AC1 is PARTIAL — the live gate run is real but attested on binaries ~50 commits stale across exactly the seams it exercises. (2) cc5 is still parked on the same question: re-run the live gate on current binaries, or mark PR #1 ready on test evidence and record the staleness in the retro (already written up there either way). (3) PR #1 is still a draft. Recorded default if you say nothing: do NOT close 4ik, leave the PR a draft, and leave Phase 2 (av8) planned but unstarted.
